summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 22000 Foundation exam with two days of FSMS requirements, HACCP, internal audits, and food safety management concepts.
audienceIntro: This ISO 22000 Foundation course suits people who support food safety management activities and need a structured introduction to FSMS requirements, HACCP, and conformity approaches.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the Certificate Holder in ISO 22000 Foundation credential after passing the exam, you must sign the PECB Code of Ethics; the source lists no professional or FSMS project experience requirement for this credential.
